verdict.rationale: A LiteLLM maintainer confirmed that function-calling works the same way as in the openai-python SDK. First-party docs say every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format regardless of provider, which implies a consistent tool-call schema. However, there is no first-party documentation specific to tool/function calling or how tool schemas are translated per provider. missing for 10: first-party tool/function-calling docs, which providers support tool calls and how request-side tool schemas are translated, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-provider tool-call consistency

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema

citations.quote: LiteLLM maintainer confirmed proxy supports streaming and function-calling in the same way as the openai-python SDK
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
Consistent output format regardless of which provider or model you use
